value.summary: 理解 Harness Engineering 的定义、在 AI 工程栈中的位置、核心组成与常见编排模式。

questions.stem: 根据资料，Harness Engineering 主要解决什么问题？

options.text: 优化单次提示词的措辞以提升回答质量
把多个 AI 智能体会话编排成结构化、可重复的工作流
训练更大规模的底层语言模型
为模型构建向量数据库以存储上下文

questions.explanation: 资料指出 Harness Engineering 是把多个 AI 智能体会话编排为结构化、可重复工作流的学科，位于提示工程与上下文工程之上。

questions.stem: 资料用哪个公式概括智能体与模型、harness 的关系？

options.text: Agent = Model + Harness
Harness = Model + Prompt
Model = Agent + Context
Agent = Prompt + Context

questions.explanation: Faros 与 Endor Labs 的资料都给出公式：Agent = Model + Harness。
questions.knowledge_point: Agent 与 Harness 的关系

questions.stem: 按照资料建议，团队从零开始实施 harness 各层时，应最先实现哪一层？

options.text: 反馈循环，因为它能实现自我纠正
质量门禁，因为它能拦截不合格产出
约束 harness，因为它能先减少失败数量
可观测性，因为它能记录全部日志

questions.explanation: Augment Code 的资料建议按顺序实施：先做约束 harness，因为它在其他机制到位前就能减少失败数量；反馈循环第二，质量门禁第三。

questions.stem: 根据资料，下列哪些属于 harness engineering 的核心组成或常见模式？

options.text: 会话编排与任务排序或并行
输出验证循环与 critic-generator 循环
decompose-solve-merge 流水线
仅依靠单次提示词完成全部工作

questions.explanation: MindStudio 的资料列出会话编排、智能体专门化、输出验证循环、任务排序或并行等核心组件，以及 critic-generator 循环、decompose-solve-merge 流水线、推测执行等常见模式；D 与 harness 的多会话编排理念相反。
questions.knowledge_point: Harness 的核心组件与模式

questions.stem: 资料认为，harness engineering 与上下文工程的区别之一在于：在智能体生成大量代码的环境中，可用自定义 linter 和结构测试来保持架构一致性。

options.text: 正确
错误

questions.explanation: MadPlay 的资料指出，这正是 harness engineering 与上下文工程最明显的区别之一：OpenAI 使用自定义 linter 和结构测试来保持架构一致性与品味。
questions.knowledge_point: Harness 与上下文工程的区别

evidence.quote: Harness engineering is the discipline of orchestrating multiple AI agent sessions into structured, repeatable workflows — it sits above prompt engineering and context engineering in the AI stack.

Teams starting from zero should implement them in order: constraint harnesses first because they reduce failure volume before anything else is in place, feedback loops second because they enable self-correction without human intervention, quality gates thi
The core components include session orchestration, agent specialization, output validation loops, and task sequencing or parallelism.
Common patterns include critic-generator loops, decompose-solve-merge pipelines, and speculative execution.

This is where harness engineering separates most clearly from context engineering. In environments where agents generate large amounts of code, OpenAI used **custom linters and structural tests** to preserve architectural consistency and taste.

 The core components include session orchestration, agent specialization, output validation loops, and task sequencing or parallelism.
 Common patterns include critic-generator loops, decompose-solve-merge pipelines, and speculative execution. [...] ## FAQ: Harness Engineering for AI Coding

### What is harness engineering in AI?

Harness engineering is the practice of structuring and orchestrating AI agent sessions into repeatable, reliable workflows. It addresses how multiple agents are coordinated — what inputs they receive, in what order they run, how their outputs are validated, and how errors are handled. It sits above prompt engineering and context engineering in the AI engineering stack. [...] MindStudio

sources.title: Harness Engineering: A Guide to AI Coding Agents | Faros
sources.excerpt:
Harness engineering is the practice that converts raw model capability into production-grade engineering work. The orchestration, verification, memory, guardrails, and observability built around an AI agent determine whether its output reaches production safely and at scale—and the teams investing in these layers are the ones consistently moving agent-assisted code into real systems. [...] ‍Harness engineering is the practice of building the surrounding software infrastructure—the harness—that allows a raw AI model to function as a reliable, autonomous agent. It involves designing tool orchestration, verification loops, memory, and safety guardrails so the AI can execute multi-step software tasks and self-correct errors in production.

### What is the difference between an AI model and an AI agent? [...] AI Industry
